Guide\n\nA small, deterministic HTTP service for D&D 5e helper calculations, combat\ntracking, campaign management, and play-by-post turn handling. It uses Rust\n1.97.0 and the standard library only: no external crates, no serde, no HTTP\nframework. HTTP is implemented directly on `std::net::TcpListener` /\n`TcpStream`, and JSON is built and parsed with string manipulation.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` removes the local database (`game.db`), builds the server with\n`cargo run`, and starts it in the foreground. The server binds to `127.0.0.1`\non the port given by the `PORT` environment variable (default `8080`). The\ndatabase path can be overridden with `DB_PATH`.\n\nVerify the server is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nReset the database and in-memory caches (registered user accounts are\npreserved so the authenticated play surface remains usable):\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/storage/reset\n# => {\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\n```\n\n## Entry point and module layout\n\n- `Cargo.toml` — package metadata. No external dependencies.\n- `run.sh` — builds and runs the server with `cargo run`.\n- `src/main.rs` — entry point, module declarations, global state, and the\n  central request dispatcher. Routing is split into `dispatch_get`,\n  `dispatch_post`, `dispatch_put`, and `dispatch_delete` helpers.\n- `src/domain.rs` — core domain types (`Combatant`, `CombatSession`, `User`,\n  `Condition`) and the global in-memory caches (`SESSIONS`, `USERS`).\n- `src/http.rs` — minimal HTTP/1.1 request parsing and response writing.\n- `src/json.rs` — hand-rolled JSON parsing helpers used by every handler.\n  Recent refactoring introduced `find_value_pos` and `scan_bracket_content` to\n  share the key-location and bracket-matching logic across all extractors.\n- `src/store.rs` — SQLite persistence via the `sqlite3` CLI tool, plus all\n  existence and lookup helpers used by the domain modules. Startup migrations\n  are consolidated through `add_column_if_missing` so older schemas can be\n  forward-migrated without changing behavior for new databases.\n- `src/auth.rs` — registration, login, and bearer-token verification.\n- `src/combat.rs` — combat sessions, initiative, conditions, and turn\n  advancement.\n- `src/campaigns.rs` — campaigns, player characters, events, scheduled\n  sessions, attendance, audit, and export.\n- `src/compendium.rs` — monsters and items stored in SQLite.\n- `src/dice.rs` — dice statistics and ability checks.\n- `src/encounters.rs` — encounter difficulty / XP calculations.\n- `src/phb.rs` — Player's Handbook rules: modifiers, proficiency, spell slots,\n  rests, and equipment load.\n- `src/dm_tools.rs` — DM-facing helpers: encounter builder, loot parcel, and\n  session recap.\n- `src/quests.rs` — quest creation, progress tracking, and summaries.\n- `src/npcs_factions.rs` — factions and NPCs with relationship summaries.\n- `src/inventory.rs` — campaign inventory and character equipment assignments.\n- `src/downtime.rs` — downtime crafting projects.\n- `src/analytics.rs` — campaign readiness score and risk reports.\n- `src/play.rs` — authenticated play-by-post campaigns: membership, turn\n  queue, narrations, actions, resolutions, nudges, the role-filtered campaign\n  document, scenes, locations, travel, rests, encounter management, character\n  ownership, character creation, level progression, and skill checks. This serializes requests and keeps the\nin-memory view consistent with the database between `save_storage` calls.\n\n### Persistence\n\nPersistence is implemented in `src/store.rs` by invoking the `sqlite3` command\nline tool. After a handler that mutates `SESSIONS` or\n`USERS` succeeds, the dispatcher calls `save_storage` to persist the change.\n\n### JSON parsing\n\n`src/json.rs` provides a small, serde-free parser. All keyed extractors build on\n`find_value_pos`, which locates the first `\"key\"` and the following colon, and\n`scan_bracket_content`, which extracts balanced bracket bodies. The public\nhelpers are:\n\n- `extract_string` / `extract_int` / `extract_bool` — scalar fields.\n- `extract_array_content` / `extract_object_content` — nested bodies.\n- `extract_top_array_content` — The\n/// resolution is appended as a public event and the turn advances to the next\n/// party member with an incremented turn number.\npub fn resolve_turn(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if current_actor != \"dm\" || (phase != \"dm\" && phase != \"exploration\") {\n        return play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"resolution\", \"dm\", text)\n        .map_err(|_| The\n/// response reports the computed modifier and the total roll + modifier.\n/// Unsupported skills or abilities return 400.\npub fn skill_check(\n    campaign_id: &str,\n    character_id: &str,\n    body: &str,\n    actor: &str,\n) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_character_id_exists(campaign_id, character_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let owner = play_campaign_member_get_abilities(campaign_id, character_id)\n            .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let ability_score = match ability {\n        \"str\" => str,\n        \"dex\" => dex,\n        \"con\" => con,\n        \"int\" => int,\n        \"wis\" => wis,\n        \"cha\" => cha,\n        _ => return Err(PlayError::BadRequest),\n    };\n    if ability_score < 1 || !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_character_id_exists(campaign_id, character_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let owner = play_campaign_member_get_owner(campaign_id, character_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n\n    let race = extract_string(body, \"race\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let class = extract_string(body, \"class\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let background = extract_string(body, \"background\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let abilities = extract_object_content(body, \"abilities\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let str = extract_int(abilities, \"str\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let dex = extract_int(abilities, \"dex\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let con = extract_int(abilities, \"con\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let int = extract_int(abilities, \"int\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let wis = extract_int(abilities, \"wis\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let cha = extract_int(abilities, \"cha\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    if !valid_race(&race) || !valid_class(&class) || !valid_background(&background) {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    if str < 1\n        || str > 30\n        || dex < 1\n        || dex > 30\n        || con < 1\n        || con > 30\n        || int < 1\n        || int > 30\n        || wis < 1\n        || wis > 30\n        || cha < 1\n        || cha > 30\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let level = 1;\n    let con_modifier = crate::phb::modifier(con);\n    let hp_max = class_hit_die(&class) + con_modifier;\n    let proficiency_bonus = crate::phb::proficiency_bonus(level);\n\n    play_campaign_member_set_build(\n        campaign_id,\n        character_id,\n        &race,\n        &class,\n        &background,\n        level,\n escape_json(&race),\n        escape_json(&class),\n        escape_json(&background),\n        level,\n        hp_max,\n        proficiency_bonus\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Resolve a skill check for a campaign reported as uninitialized with version 0.\npub fn storage_status() -> Result<(i64, bool), String> {\n    let sql = \"SELECT version, initialized FROM schema_meta WHERE version = 1;\";\n    match sqlite_query(sql) {\n        Ok(output) => {\n            let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            let objects = extract_objects(content);\n            if objects.is_empty() {\n                return Ok((0, false));\n            }\n            let obj = objects[0];\n            let version = extract_int(obj, \"version\").unwrap_or(0);\n            let initialized = extract_int(obj, \"initialized\").unwrap_or(0) != 0;\n            Ok((version, initialized))\n        }\n        Err(_) => Ok((0, false)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load persistent users and combat sessions from SQLite into the in-memory\n/// caches.\n///\n/// This is called once at startup. Existing in-memory contents are cleared and\n/// replaced by the persisted state.\npub fn load_storage(\n    sessions: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    users.clear();\n    sessions.clear();\n\n    let users_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT username, role, password_hash FROM users;\")?;\n    let users_content = extract_top_array_content(&users_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(users_content) {\n        let username = extract_string(obj, \"username\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing username\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let role = extract_string(obj, \"role\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing role\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let password_hash = extract_string(obj, \"password_hash\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing password_hash\")?\n            .to_string();\n        users.insert(\n            username.clone(),\n            User {\n                username,\n                role,\n                password_hash,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sessions_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions;\")?;\n    let sessions_content = extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n                order,\n                conditions,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Persist the entire in-memory state to SQLite.\n///\n/// This function is intentionally simple: it deletes all rows from the mutable\n/// tables and re-inserts them from the in-memory caches. The busy timeout\n/// helps prevent conflicts with rapid sequential requests.\npub fn save_storage(\n    sessions: &std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut sql = String::from(\n        \"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\\nDELETE FROM conditions;\\nDELETE FROM combatants;\\nDELETE FROM combat_sessions;\\nDELETE FROM users;\\n\",\n    );\n\n    for user in users.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}');\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&user.username),\n            sql_escape(&user.role),\n            sql_escape(&user.password_hash)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    for session in sessions.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES ('{}', {}, {});\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&session.id),\n            session.round,\n            session.turn_index\n        ));\n        for (position, c) in session.order.iter().enumerate() {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, position) VALUES ('{}', '{}', {}, {}, {});\\n\",\n                sql_escape(&session.id),\n                sql_escape(&c.name),\n                c.score,\n                c.dex,\n                position\n            ));\n        }\n        for (target, list) in &session.conditions {\n            for c in list {\n                sql.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', {});\\n\",\n                    sql_escape(&session.id),\n                    sql_escape(target),\n                    sql_escape(&c.name),\n                    c.remaining\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Check whether a compendium slug already exists in the given table.\npub fn compendium_slug_exists(table: &str, slug: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {\n    let sql = initialized = extract_int(obj, \"initialized\").unwrap_or(0) != 0;\n            Ok((version, initialized))\n        }\n        Err(_) => Ok((0, false)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load persistent users and combat sessions from SQLite into the in-memory\n/// caches.\n///\n/// This is called once at startup. Existing in-memory contents are cleared and\n/// replaced by the persisted state.\npub fn load_storage(\n    sessions: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    users.clear();\n    sessions.clear();\n\n    let users_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT username, role, password_hash FROM users;\")?;\n    let users_content = extract_top_array_content(&users_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(users_content) {\n        let username = extract_string(obj, \"username\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing username\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let role = extract_string(obj, \"role\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing role\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let password_hash = extract_string(obj, \"password_hash\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing password_hash\")?\n            .to_string();\n        users.insert(\n            username.clone(),\n            User {\n                username,\n                role,\n                password_hash,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sessions_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions;\")?;\n    let sessions_content = extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n                order,\n                conditions,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Persist the entire in-memory state to SQLite.\n///\n/// This function is intentionally simple: it deletes all rows from the mutable\n/// tables and re-inserts them from the in-memory caches. The busy timeout\n/// helps prevent conflicts with rapid sequential requests.\npub fn save_storage(\n    sessions: &std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut sql = String::from(\n        \"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\\nDELETE FROM conditions;\\nDELETE FROM combatants;\\nDELETE FROM combat_sessions;\\nDELETE FROM users;\\n\",\n    );\n\n    for user in users.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}');\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&user.username),\n            sql_escape(&user.role),\n            sql_escape(&user.password_hash)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    for session in sessions.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES ('{}', {}, {});\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&session.id),\n            session.round,\n            session.turn_index\n        ));\n        for (position, c) in session.order.iter().enumerate() {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, position) VALUES ('{}', '{}', {}, {}, {});\\n\",\n                sql_escape(&session.id),\n                sql_escape(&c.name),\n                c.score,\n                c.dex,\n                position\n            ));\n        }\n        for (target, list) in &session.conditions {\n            for c in list {\n                sql.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', {});\\n\",\n                    sql_escape(&session.id),\n                    sql_escape(target),\n                    sql_escape(&c.name),\n                    c.remaining\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Check whether a compendium slug already exists in the given table.\npub fn compendium_slug_exists(table: &str, slug: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {\n    let sql = format!(\n        \"SELECT 1 FROM {} WHERE slug = '{}';\",\n        table,\n        sql_escape(slug)\n    );\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n    Ok(!output.trim().is_empty())\n}\n\npub fn stream in listener.incoming() {\n        if let Ok(mut stream) = stream {\n            let _ = dispatch_request(&mut stream);\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Role requirement for bearer-token authorization.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy)]\nenum AuthRequirement {\n    /// Any valid bearer token, regardless of role.\n    Any,\n    /// Only a registered user with role `\"dm\"`.\n    Dm,\n    /// Only a registered user with role `\"player\"`.\n    Player,\n}\n\n/// Extract a `Bearer` token from the `Authorization` header, if present.\nfn extract_auth_token(req: &str) -> Option<&str> {\n    for line in req.lines() {\n        let lower = line.to_lowercase();\n        if lower.starts_with(\"authorization:\") {\n            let val = line.splitn(2, ':').nth(1)?.trim();\n            if val.to_lowercase().starts_with(\"bearer \") {\n                return Some(val[6..].trim());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\n/// Require a valid bearer token with the given role.\n///\n/// Returns the authenticated username on success. Missing or malformed\n/// credentials return `Unauthorized`; a role mismatch returns `Forbidden`.\nfn require_auth(\n    req: &str,\n    users: &HashMap<String, User>,\n    requirement: AuthRequirement,\n) -> Result<String, auth::AuthError> {\n    let token = extract_auth_token(req).ok_or(auth::AuthError::Unauthorized)?;\n    let (username, role) = auth::verify_bearer(token, users)?;\n    match requirement {\n        AuthRequirement::Any => Ok(username),\n        AuthRequirement::Dm if role == \"dm\" => Ok(username),\n        AuthRequirement::Player if role == \"player\" => Ok(username),\n        _ => Err(auth::AuthError::Forbidden),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Parse one HTTP request, route it, and write the response.\n///\n/// Both in-memory state maps are locked for the duration of the request so that\n/// reads and writes are serialized and persistence is consistent.\nfn dispatch_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let req = 400, BAD_REQUEST);\n    }\n    let method = parts[0];\n    let path = parts[1];\n    let body = extract_body(&req);\n\n    let mut sessions = SESSIONS.lock().unwrap();\n    let mut users = USERS.lock().unwrap();\n\n    let (status, response) = match method {\n        \"GET\" => dispatch_get(path, &req, &sessions, &users),\n        \"POST\" => dispatch_post(path, body, &req, &mut sessions, &mut users),\n        \"PUT\" => dispatch_put(path, body, &req, &mut sessions, &mut users),\n        \"DELETE\" => dispatch_delete(path, body, &req, &mut sessions, &mut users),\n        _ => (404, NOT_FOUND.to_string()),\n    };\n    respond(stream, status, &response)\n}\n\n/// Return the body portion of a fully read HTTP request.\nfn extract_body(req: &str) -> &str {\n    if let
